task_spec: Implement an Account with deposit, place_hold/release_hold/capture_hold, available(), withdraw, and transfer. Invariant: a hold earmarks funds that cannot be spent; withdrawals and transfers may only draw on SPENDABLE funds (balance minus active holds), never on money that is currently held.

bugs.description: withdraw checks `amount > self.balance` but must check `amount > self.available()`. As written it ignores active holds, so held (earmarked) funds can be withdrawn — e.g. deposit 100, place_hold 80, then withdraw 100 succeeds, leaving available() at -80 and violating the core invariant. transfer inherits the same flaw. The check must use available(), not balance.

provenance.note: bespoke stateful interaction bug; no textbook pattern, no worked example
